ai.help: How can I help you today?

intro.title: AI Instant Interview
intro.description: A natural, voice-led conversation with your AI interviewer. Take a breath—we’ll guide you through it.

steps.question: 1. Your interviewer asks each question out loud. The question text stays hidden.
steps.answer: 2. Press Answer question and respond naturally.
steps.finish: 3. Finish with the button, or pause for 3 seconds after speaking.
steps.review: 4. Review your transcript, speak again if needed, then submit.

interviewer.audioOnly: Listen carefully—the interview question is audio-only.

answer.microphoneHint: Your microphone starts only after you press the button.

recording.label: Recording
recording.finishHint: Finish with the button, or pause for 3 seconds to submit.

transcribing.title: Transcribing your answer…
transcribing.description: This usually takes just a moment.

submitting.title: Alex is considering your answer…
submitting.description: The next question will play automatically.

proposal.submittedWithInterview: Proposal submitted. Start the AI interview whenever you’re ready.
proposal.readyDescription: This client enabled an AI interview for the job. You can start it now or return here when you’re ready.
proposal.completedDescription: Your interview responses were submitted successfully.

actions.browseToChoose: Browse jobs to choose an interview role

errors.chooseJob: Choose a job before starting an AI interview.
errors.startFailed: The AI interview could not be started. Please try again.
errors.noQuestions: Cannot start AI interview. Because this job post does not have interview questions.
errors.incompleteSession: The interview service returned an incomplete session. Please try again.
errors.transcriptionFailed: Your answer could not be transcribed. Please record it again.
errors.unsupportedRecording: This browser does not support microphone recording. Please use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari browser.
errors.recordingFailed: The browser could not record your answer. Please try again.
errors.noAudioCaptured: No audio was captured. Please record your answer again.
errors.microphoneDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow microphone access and try again.
errors.microphoneUnavailable: The microphone could not be opened. Please check your device and try again.
errors.noTranscript: No transcript was captured. Please speak again before submitting.
errors.submitFailed: Your answer could not be submitted. Please try again.
errors.nextQuestionMissing: The interview service did not return the next question. Please try again.
errors.replayFailed: The interviewer voice could not be replayed. Please try again.
errors.voiceUnavailable: The interviewer voice is unavailable. Please refresh and try again.
errors.audioStreamFailed: The interviewer voice could not be played. Please try again.

complete.title: Thank you for using our AI interview
complete.message: Your responses have been submitted successfully. You’ll receive a notification soon if your application is accepted.
complete.emailDescription: We’ll also send the decision to your email.
